description: Fetch a single message by id. See get_thread for the detail levels and the account rule.

account.description: Which registered mailbox: a label from list_accounts; empty means the default account.

detail.description: How much comes back. 'metadata' = headers and snippet only, the cheapest fetch; it carries NO attachment list, because Gmail's metadata format does not return the MIME tree at all. 'text' (default) adds the attachment list plus each body as readable text, CONVERTING a message that ships only HTML rather than dumping markup; each message carries bodySource so you know which you got. 'raw_html' is 'text' with the markup exactly as sent, for parsing it yourself.

name: get_message
title: Get message
